::: {.lit-card}
[90% of 1,380]{.lit-num}

[Atmosphere. A graph neural network trained on reanalysis outperforms the best operational deterministic forecast on 90% of 1,380 verification targets; a 10-day forecast takes under a minute.]{.lit-msg}

[Lam, R., et al. (2023). Learning skillful medium-range global weather forecasting. *Science*, 382, 1416–1421.]{.lit-cite}
:::

::: {.lit-card}
[1.5 years]{.lit-num}

[Ocean. A convolutional network trained on climate simulations, then on reanalysis, forecasts El Niño with skill up to one and a half years ahead.]{.lit-msg}

[Ham, Y.-G., Kim, J.-H., & Luo, J.-J. (2019). Deep learning for multi-year ENSO forecasts. *Nature*, 573, 568–572.]{.lit-cite}
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.lit-card}
[5 days]{.lit-num}

[Land water. In ungauged watersheds, a model trained on gauged ones predicts extreme floods 5 days ahead as reliably as the global flood system's same-day nowcast.]{.lit-msg}

[Nearing, G., et al. (2024). Global prediction of extreme floods in ungauged watersheds. *Nature*, 627, 559–563.]{.lit-cite}
:::

::: {.lit-card}
[2 vs 13,451]{.lit-num .bad}

[Solid Earth. A logistic regression with 2 parameters matches the aftershock-location skill of a deep network with 13,451.]{.lit-msg}

[Mignan, A., & Broccardo, M. (2019). One neuron versus deep learning in aftershock prediction. *Nature*, 574, E1–E3.]{.lit-cite}
